description: Source code implementing a JSON lexer for parsing JSON tokens, including token definitions, lexing logic, and error handling.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: A JSON lexer that tokenizes JSON data for parsing.

classes.name: token
classes.description: Represents a single JSON token with type, value, and position.

classes.name: tokenKind
classes.description: Enumeration of token types such as string, number, boolean, null, delimiters.

methods.name: FetchToken
methods.description: Scans input data to identify and set the next JSON token.

methods.name: UnescapeStringToken
methods.description: Performs unescaping of string tokens, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: fetchNull
methods.description: Checks and consumes 'null' keyword in JSON.

methods.name: fetchTrue
methods.description: Checks and consumes 'true' keyword in JSON.

methods.name: fetchFalse
methods.description: Checks and consumes 'false' keyword in JSON.

methods.name: fetchNumber
methods.description: Scans a number literal token from input data.

methods.name: fetchString
methods.description: Scans a string literal token, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Resets current token to allow scanning the next token.

methods.name: Ok
methods.description: Returns true if no fatal error occurred during lexing.

methods.name: errParse
methods.description: Records a parse error with context information.

methods.name: errSyntax
methods.description: Records a syntax error.

methods.name: errInvalidToken
methods.description: Records an invalid token error, optionally as a non-fatal error.

methods.name: Delim
methods.description: Verifies and consumes a specific delimiter token.

methods.name: IsDelim
methods.description: Checks if the next token is a specific delimiter.

methods.name: Null
methods.description: Verifies and consumes a null token.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the next token is null.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips the current token.

methods.name: SkipRecursive
methods.description: Skips an entire array or object recursively.

methods.name: Raw
methods.description: Returns the raw byte slice of the next JSON value.

methods.name: IsStart
methods.description: Checks if lexer is at the start of input.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Reads remaining whitespace and reports error if non-whitespace remains.

methods.name: UnsafeString
methods.description: Returns string value of current token, may point to input buffer.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Reads and returns a string literal token.

methods.name: StringIntern
methods.description: Reads a string literal and interns it.

methods.name: Bytes
methods.description: Reads a string literal and decodes base64 into bytes.

methods.name: Bool
methods.description: Reads a boolean token (true/false).

methods.name: JsonNumber
methods.description: Fetches a json.Number token.

methods.name: Interface
methods.description: Fetches a generic interface{} value from the next token.

methods.name: WantComma
methods.description: Sets state to expect a comma before next token.

methods.name: WantColon
methods.description: Sets state to expect a colon before next token.
